title: SWAP5 WOFOST81 Migration Preservation

validated_semantics: combined corrected DRLV consumed exactly once from oldest cohorts
surviving cohorts shifted and aged once
new youngest leaf cohort inserted with corrected SLA
LAIEXP carryover captured and reused across threshold 6

donor_n_ordering.request: prepared during WOFOST81 daily update after organ growth rates and DRLV are known; it consumes committed pre-step biomass/N state plus gross organ growth rates
donor_n_ordering.supply_apply: applied later when external Soil-N supply is available, using the saved pre-step biomass and organ death rates
donor_n_ordering.transactional_implication: SWAP5 must expose a candidate-only prepare request phase and a later apply supply/finalize phase; rejected candidates must not mutate committed N state

architecture_decision: Keep legacy WOFOST modules unchanged. Compose a versioned WOFOST81 daily candidate from the existing common carbon/DVS calculation, the qualified WOFOST81 assimilation and rate-correction layers, the qualified WOFOST81 leaf structural application, and the source-faithful N request/apply kernel.
scientific_interpretation: Carbon/N leaf semantics required by the donor are now separately qualified. The next gate is atomic daily composition over the composite crop+N owner, with N request prepared from the committed pre-step state and N supply applied only to the candidate before acceptance.
next_permitted_action: Implement and qualify a candidate-only two-phase WOFOST81 daily composition: prepare common/carbon rates and corrected WOFOST81 leaf rates plus N request without mutating committed state; then apply supplied N to candidate N state and finalize crop structural state. Prove rejected/discarded candidates cannot leak N or crop mutation. Do not activate runtime yet.
exclusions: no replacement of existing legacy WOFOST path
